items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Theorem 4.7.6 at source lines 736-742: for a fiberwise transformation f and points x : A, v : Q(x), the fiber of the total map at (x,v) is equivalent to the fiber of the component f(x) at v. The author's proof (source lines 743-760) is a five-step chain of equivalences rather than a citation: it unfolds the total-space fiber and reassociates the sigma types (lines 745-750), applies the characterisation of paths in sigma types to turn a pair equality into a path in A together with a transported equality (lines 751-752), reorders the components (lines 753-754) and then eliminates the contractible path component using the based path space, the omission of contractible components and associativity (lines 755-759). The statement contains only the resulting equivalence of fibers; the intermediate type and the input of each step are invisible.
